He is being evaluated for heart transplant, and is referred for heart transplant Psychosocial Assessment.     Information for this assessment was obtained through an interview with the pt's mother and father and review of the medical records. There is no reported history of DV or involvement with DCF.       Adherence:  There are no concerns for adherence identified at this time.
